answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond that unlocks only after it finishes a verifiable useful job, such as inspecting cargo at a wharf or calibrating a sensor on a knoll, checked by two independent peers. A sybil operator must then pay a fresh bond and do real work for every fake identity, while one honest agent pays once. Duplicates are exposed when two identities submit identical sensor readings, and both bonds are slashed. Small agents may instead join a yarrow cooperative that pools bonds and vouches for members, forfeiting its own stake if any member cheats.
